threshold: NPIC: "Cats that have been exposed by accident to products with high (45-65%) levels of permethrin may seem anxious and can't walk normally. They may also have muscle tremors and seizures and they may die from the exposure." VCA (cats): "any exposure may be fatal"
safe_exceptions: No source in my family calls any permethrin product safe for cats. Dogs: VCA "The use of pyrethrins or pyrethroids is generally safe in dogs".
effect: Cats metabolise pyrethroids slowly; tremors, seizures and death after a dog product is applied to the cat or licked/groomed off a treated dog.
